description: Quest objectives point at a circle on the map instead of an exact spot, as in Fallout 76.
x-help:
An area belongs to one quest objective target. The circle has a radius (fixed, or read from a global) and is drawn on the map and compass; the real marker is hidden so the player has to search the circle.

To add one, pick the quest, its objective and target numbers, and a radius. 'Centered' puts the circle on the target; otherwise the target sits somewhere inside it. The conditions are copied from the original quest and are rarely edited.
